# System V cycle generator

Builds the System V cycle of SUS-I1 from the records:

<!-- terms:end -->

| Output | What it is |
|---|---|
| `docs/vcycle/index.html` | Interactive page: maturity, gate scrubber, requirement trace, change ripple. Open it from a local checkout. |
| `docs/wiki/System-V-Cycle.md` | Wiki page with the still, the system-level blocks and the maturity ladder |
| `docs/wiki/images/vcycle-system.svg` | Still of the system-level V |

```bash
python -m tools.vcycle.build_vcycle            # write the outputs
python -m tools.vcycle.build_vcycle --check    # CI: fail if any output is stale
python -m tools.vcycle.build_vcycle --history /tmp/vcycle.html   # local copy with the evidence clock
python -m unittest discover -s tools/vcycle/tests -t .
```

`page.html` is the page source; the generator fills in the record data. Edit the records or `page.html`, never the
outputs.

The evidence clock replays the git history of the records. It is only in the `--history` copy: a committed page that
embedded history would be stale after every commit that touches a record, so its `--check` could never pass.

Maturity colours are computed from record status for orientation. Nothing here reviews, verifies or accepts anything
(rule R13). The change requests marked "example" in the change ripple are not records; real ones come from `changes/`.
